description_en: Queries a list of media editing and production jobs that meet the specified conditions. You can query the jobs based on the job state and type
description_zh: 列出符合条件的合成任务，可根据任务状态、类型查询
kebab_example: aliyun ice list-media-producing-jobs --status Success --job-type EditingJob --start-time 2017-01-11T12:00:00Z --end-time 2022-02-02T23:59:59Z --keyword 000020b48fb04483915d4f2cd8ac0000 --project-id 000000927cfb53d05b96c1bfe1000000 --master-job-id 0000008750b54e3c976a47da6f000000 --next-token 8EqYpQbZ6Eh7+Zz8DxVYoQ== --max-results 100 --sort-by CreationTime:Desc --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListMediaProducingJobs

parameters.help_en:
The job state.

Valid values:

Init: The job is initialized.

Failed: The job failed.

Success: The job is successful.

Processing: The job is in progress
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The job type.

Valid values:

LiveEditingJob: live editing job.

EditingJob: regular template-based editing job

VETemplateJob: advanced template-based editing job
parameters.name: job_type

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. The maximum time range between EndTime and StartTime cannot exceed 30 days. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，与StartTime相差不超过30天。格式为yyyy-mm-ddthh:mm:ssz（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The search keyword. For example, you can use a job ID as the keyword to search for jobs
parameters.help_zh: 搜索关键词，可以根据任务ID搜索
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en: The ID of the online editing project
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the quick video production job. If this parameter is specified, the subjobs of the quick video production job are queried
parameters.help_zh: 一键成片任务Id，当此条件不为空时，为查询一键成片任务的子任务
parameters.name: master_job_id

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries to return.

Default value: 10. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh:
本次请求所返回的最大记录条数。

最大值：100，默认值：10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The sorting parameter. By default, the query results are sorted by creation time in descending order.

Valid values:

CreationTime:Asc: sorted by creation time in ascending order.

CreationTime:Desc: sorted by creation time in descending order
parameters.help_zh: 排序参数，默认按创建时间倒序
parameters.name: sort_by

MaxResults.description_en:
The maximum number of entries returned.

Default value: 10. Valid values: 1 to 100
MaxResults.description_zh:
本次请求所返回的最大记录条数。

最大值：100，默认值：10

MediaProducingJobList.description_en: The queried media editing and production jobs

items.description_en: The queried media editing and production job

Code.description_zh: 剪辑合成作业失败错误码

CompleteTime.description_en: The time when the job was complete. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
CompleteTime.description_zh: 剪辑合成作业完成时间，格式为utc时间

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the job was created. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC

Duration.description_en: The duration of the output file. Unit: seconds
Duration.description_zh: 输出成品的时长，单位：秒

JobId.description_en: The ID of the online editing job

MediaId.description_en: The media asset ID of the output file

MediaURL.description_en: The URL of the output file

Message.description_en: The returned message. Note: Pay attention to this parameter if the job failed
Message.description_zh: 剪辑合成作业错误信息注：作业失败时关注该字段
Message.example: The resource operated InputFile is bad

ModifiedTime.description_en: The time when the job was last modified

ProjectId.description_en: The ID of the online editing project

TemplateId.description_en: The ID of the online editing template

UserData.description_en: The user-defined data in the JSON format

NextToken.description_en: A pagination token. It can be used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results
